luiskr.com / core/utils/dom / viewportWidth

function viewportWidth(): number

Defined in: core/utils/dom.ts:221

Returns window.innerWidth, memoized within the current task. The first call takes the (layout-forcing) hit; every subsequent caller in the same task reuses the number — after DOM writes this keeps a burst of N reads down to a single possible reflow at the batch head.

Returns

number

viewport width in px, or 0 without a window (SSR/tests).
